strings.¿Cómo creo un servidor de Minecraft en m: How do I make a Minecraft server on my PC?
strings.Instala MC-ServerLauncher, pulsa «+ Nuev: Install MC-ServerLauncher, click “+ New”, choose “Create a new one”, then the version and type (Vanilla, Paper, Purpur, Forge, NeoForge or Fabric), accept the Minecraft EULA, and the app downloads the official files and generates the world for you.
strings.¿Cómo hostear un servidor de Minecraft g: How do I host a Minecraft server for free?
strings.Hospedándolo tú mismo en tu propio orden: By hosting it yourself on your own computer. MC-ServerLauncher downloads the official server, configures it and keeps it running, and the built-in tunnel gives it a public address so your friends can join without a monthly fee or router port forwarding.
strings.¿Es mejor un servidor gratis en mi PC o: Is a free server on my PC better than a paid one?
strings.En tu PC no pagas nada, no hay límites d: On your PC you pay nothing, there are no player or mod limits imposed by a plan, and the world is yours: the files are on your disk. In exchange, it is only available while your computer is on. A paid one is always online, but it costs a fee and usually caps RAM and mods.
strings.Sí. Es gratuito y de código abierto: pue: Yes. It is free and open source: you can review the code on GitHub. Every download (Minecraft, Java, mods and the app's own updates) is checked against its official checksum before running. The app's own updates are also signed with a key that isn't on GitHub.
strings.¿Necesito abrir puertos del router para: Do I need to forward router ports to play with friends?
strings.No. La app integra un túnel de Playit.gg: No. The app includes a Playit.gg tunnel: it gives you a public address you can share, without touching your router settings.
strings.¿Funciona en Linux y macOS?: Does it work on Linux and macOS?
strings.Sí. Hay AppImage para Linux y DMG para m: Yes. There is an AppImage for Linux and a DMG for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), plus the Windows installer.
strings.¿Puedo instalar mods y plugins?: Can I install mods and plugins?
strings.Sí, desde el buscador de Modrinth integr: Yes, from the built-in Modrinth browser, which automatically filters by your Minecraft version and your server type.
strings.¿Qué pasa si el servidor se cae?: What happens if the server goes down?
strings.Se reinicia solo (hasta tres intentos) y: It restarts by itself (up to three attempts) and shows you why, reading Minecraft's crash report, and notifies you as well.
strings.Descarga MC-ServerLauncher y monta tu se: Download MC-ServerLauncher and set up your server today.

strings.Estadísticas anónimas sin cookies (GoatC: Anonymous, cookie-free statistics (GoatCounter): no personal data is stored.
Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
strings.Respuestas directas a lo que más se busc: Straight answers to what people search for most when setting up a Minecraft server.
strings.Gasta solo la memoria que necesita: It uses only the memory it needs
strings.La app decide cuánta RAM puede usar cada: The app decides how much RAM each server may use and Java gives back what it does not need: an empty server goes from 3.5-4.7 GB to about 1 GB. It learns from how you use it and, if the PC runs short of memory, tightens sooner.
strings.Te avisa cuando va al límite: It warns you when it is at its limit
strings.Una tarjeta muestra los TPS del servidor: A card shows the server’s TPS and a band appears only when something is wrong for a while. “See solutions” offers one-click fixes: lower the distances, more memory, or mods that speed it up.
strings.Se apaga solo cuando está vacío: It stops by itself when empty
strings.Para el servidor cuando no queda nadie y: It stops the server when nobody is left and starts it when a friend tries to join, without wasting RAM or CPU.
strings.La memoria real que ocupa el servidor y: The memory the server really holds and its live TPS, a console search, and each player’s profile: when they joined, what they said and what they mined. OPs, bans and whitelist with buttons instead of commands.

strings.¿Cómo hostear un servidor de Minecraft g: Como hospedar um servidor de Minecraft grátis?
strings.Hospedándolo tú mismo en tu propio orden: Hospedando você mesmo no seu próprio computador. O MC-ServerLauncher baixa o servidor oficial, configura e mantém em funcionamento, e o túnel integrado dá a ele um endereço público para os seus amigos entrarem sem pagar mensalidade nem abrir portas do roteador.
strings.¿Es mejor un servidor gratis en mi PC o: É melhor um servidor grátis no meu PC ou um pago?
strings.En tu PC no pagas nada, no hay límites d: No seu PC você não paga nada, não há limites de jogadores nem de mods impostos por um plano, e o mundo é seu: os arquivos ficam no seu disco. Em troca, só fica disponível enquanto o computador estiver ligado. Um servidor pago fica sempre online, mas custa uma mensalidade e costuma limitar RAM e mods.
